# Systemic Safety & Governance {#sec-systemic-safety}

> **Stub.** The fifth core pillar — risk beyond a single model or agent. Chronological
> deep-dive:
>
> - **Catastrophic & systemic risk** — malicious use (CBRN, cyber), malfunction, and
>   structural societal risk [@hendrycks2023catastrophic; @intlaisafety2025].
> - **Frontier safety frameworks** — Anthropic Responsible Scaling Policy, OpenAI
>   Preparedness Framework, DeepMind Frontier Safety Framework; capability thresholds and
>   commitments.
> - **Standards & regulation** — NIST AI RMF (+ GenAI Profile), ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act;
>   *US EO 14110 (2023) rescinded Jan 2025 → NIST/CAISI track*.
> - **Disclosure** — model cards, system cards, safety cases [@hilton2025safetycases].
> - **Compute & ecosystem governance** — provenance/watermarking, hardware-enabled mechanisms.
